blocks.raw: Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) for end customers is an access management solution designed for customer-facing applications. CIAM is essential for brands to provide secure and seamless authentication for their customers.
blocks.text: Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) for end customers is an access management solution designed for customer-facing applications. CIAM is essential for brands to provide secure and seamless authentication for their customers.

blocks.raw: Authentication methods can include a simple login with a username and password, social sign-in that allows customers to log in using their social media credentials, OTP-based authentication, single sign-on and more.
blocks.text: Authentication methods can include a simple login with a username and password, social sign-in that allows customers to log in using their social media credentials, OTP-based authentication, single sign-on and more.

blocks.raw: Capillary offers multiple options to meet a brand's authentication needs for customer-facing applications:
blocks.text: Capillary offers multiple options to meet a brand's authentication needs for customer-facing applications:

blocks.raw:
* **[Auth for First-Party Apps](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/auth-for-first-party-apps)** - Developed by Capillary and applicable for brands that require basic authentication capabilities for their customer-facing applications.
* **[oAuth2 Authorization Code Flow and SSO for Partner Apps - Using Ory Hydra](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/oauth2-authorization-code-flow-and-sso-for-partner-apps-using-ory-hydra)** - Enables customers to log in via the brand’s customer-facing app and access authorised partner apps without re-entering credentials.
* **[Integration with External CIAMs](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/integration-with-external-ciams)** - Applicable for brands seeking enhanced security, compliance with standards like OpenID, and support for diverse user authentication methods through integration with external CIAM solutions.
